weekend_race.race_comments: Chase Briscoe has won the The Great American Getaway 400 Presented by VISITPA.COM at Pocono Raceway, his third victory in the NASCAR Cup Series. Prior to the start of the race, the following vehicle(s) dropped to the rear of the field under penalty: Nos. 10, 12, 21, 23, 24, 51 (Unapproved adjustments), No. 44 (Multiple inspection failures).
